label: use test automation tools
_note: Draft written by the build; the team should review it against the QA module before a pilot.

items.question: Name two kinds of test that are worth automating and one kind that is usually better done by a person. Say why for each.
items.modelAnswer:
Worth automating: regression tests that run after every change (they repeat the same steps many times), and data-driven tests that run one flow with many inputs. Better done by a person: exploratory or usability testing, because it needs judgement about what feels wrong and changes every time.

The rule of thumb: automate what is repeated and stable; keep people on what needs judgement or changes often.

items.question: An automated UI test passes on your laptop but fails about one run in five on the build server. What is a likely cause, and how would you fix it?
items.modelAnswer:
It is a flaky test, most often a timing problem: the test clicks or reads an element before the page has finished loading or updating. Other causes are tests that share data and run in a different order.

Fix: wait for a specific condition (the element is visible, the request has finished) instead of a fixed sleep, and give each test its own data so order doesn't matter.

items.question: What does a CI pipeline do with your automated tests, and why does that help a team?
items.modelAnswer:
Continuous integration runs the automated tests on a server every time someone pushes code or opens a pull request, and reports pass or fail before the change is merged.

It helps because a break is found within minutes, by the person who caused it, while the change is still fresh, instead of days later during manual testing.

mastery.text: Which test is the best first candidate for automation?
options: A one-off check of a new logo
A login regression test run after every release
Exploring a new feature for odd behaviour
Asking users if a page is easy to read

mastery.text: A Selenium or Playwright test clicks a button before the page has loaded and fails now and then. What is the best fix?
options: Add a fixed 10-second sleep
Delete the test
Wait until the button is visible before clicking
Run the test only on your own laptop

mastery.text: What is the main job of a CI server such as GitHub Actions or Jenkins in testing?
options: To write test cases for you
To run the automated tests on every change and report the result
To replace manual testers entirely
To store screenshots of the app

mastery.text: Your automated tests all share one test account and fail when run in a different order. What should you change?
options: Give each test its own data or reset the data before it
Always run the tests in alphabetical order
Run fewer tests
Turn off the failing assertions

mastery.text: Which statement about test automation is true?
options: Automated tests find every bug
Once written, automated tests never need maintenance
Automation is best for repeated, stable checks; people are better at exploratory testing
Automated tests should only run before a final release
